description: Water Harvesting Assessment Toolbox is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by University of Arizona | Water Resources Research Center; U.S. Bureau of Reclamation | WaterSMART Program; University of Arizona | Water Sustainability Program. This tool can help communities in the southwestern United States understand the role water harvesting can play in meeting water resource challenges while providing multiple additional benefits. It also introduces water harvesting techniques and suggests ways to implement locally appropriate water harvesting efforts. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Heat, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Cultural and Community Services, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
